hotspots.title: Trump Midterm Rally Frenzy
hotspots.blurb: President Trump is criss‑crossing key battleground states, headlining rallies in Nebraska, Texas and beyond, while GOP candidates rally around his appearances. The coverage is saturated with enthusiastic language, traffic disruptions and calls to vote.
hotspots.affect: The constant stream of rally reporting fuels outrage and triumph, positioning the rallies as the linchpin of the midterm strategy.

hotspots.title: Trump‑Funded Ad Controversy
hotspots.blurb: A wave of reporting highlights Trump's response to criticism over taxpayer‑funded TV ads, with his super PAC stepping in to pay and his defense of the ads becoming a flashpoint in the media.
hotspots.affect: The story pits Trump against accusations of abusing public funds, generating heated debate over election‑related spending.

hotspots.title: Vance Alaska Rally Surge
hotspots.blurb: Vice President JD Vance has made multiple stops in Alaska, holding rallies in Fairbanks and Anchorage, drawing both fervent support and protest, and emphasizing the state's pivotal toss‑up races.
hotspots.affect: The intense local coverage underscores a high‑stakes contest in a swing state, with vivid descriptions of crowds and confrontations.

hotspots.title: Immigration Crackdown & Migrant Policy
hotspots.blurb: Multiple reports focus on the Trump administration’s aggressive immigration actions: new lawyers for migrant kids, a blocked $1.8 M fine on migrants, a massive denaturalization push, and voter concerns in Maine.
hotspots.affect: These pieces weave a narrative of authoritarian enforcement, sparking fear and moral panic among both supporters and opponents.

hotspots.title: Diesel Tax Relief Debate
hotspots.blurb: The administration’s push to suspend taxes on on‑road dyed diesel and the executive order aimed at lowering fuel costs have generated mixed reactions ahead of the midterms.
hotspots.affect: The story mixes economic anxiety with political maneuvering, prompting both criticism and praise in the coverage.
